body: Follow-up to #5478 and Inbox #5486. The native Goal itself remained active after a bounded service turn and generated automatic continuations even when the deterministic watchdog did not wake it. This change makes each watchdog wake produce at most one Master Goal turn and pauses a still-active Goal in finally. Installer now deploys the bounded controller and its user service. Focused suite: 8/8 PASS.
title: Bound C2 Master Goal to deterministic wakes
